metadata.title: SAAM: review a completed result, approve Export, and retrieve the machine file
metadata.model-kind: Descriptive logical component model; no new SAAM contract or implementation change.
metadata.scope: Begins with an existing completed neutral path and qualified schedule. Covers Studio review, approval of that displayed result, captured-input translation, preparation receipt, and transient HTTP download.
metadata.abstraction-level: In-process modules, browser code and a worker boundary. A service node denotes a logical software responsibility, not an independently deployed microservice.
outside-scope: Scheduling and qualification before the completed output is published
Profile authoring and optional remembered-setup persistence
Physical printer operation and confirmation that the browser saved the file
metadata.evidence-limit: Descriptions attached to named contracts preserve the published responsibility statements. Relationships and flows are a manually reviewed projection of the cited source, not a generated scanner map. Existing scanner evidence is stale; no conformance audit was run.
architectural-invariants: The person choosing Export in Studio is the one confirmation; no second settings approval is introduced.
Export uses the displayed completed-output identity and captured plan, machine, path and schedule. Later edits or replacement generation cannot retarget that invocation.
A ready Export starts outside the Studio edit/generation queue.
Export checks captured schedule assumptions and prepares physical transfers; it does not call Scheduler or change deposition order.
The selected machine extension supplies executable writer code; captured machine/profile/template data supplies its inputs.
Machine files are transient artifacts outside the print bundle. Bundle retains neutral work, captured inputs, attribution and factual export-prepared receipts.
Export preparation, HTTP retrieval, browser save completion and machine execution are distinct facts.
Writer failure preserves saved work. Receipt or remembered-setup failure after preparation is reported without discarding the prepared program.

verification.checks-do-not-establish: Runtime conformance or physical print success. No SAAM test suite or scanner audit was run.

nodes.name: Person
nodes.description: Request work and review it through Studio or shared command entry.

nodes.name: Studio Export confirmation
nodes.description: Show the work and settings selected for Export and receive the person’s approval.

nodes.name: Studio review and HTTP Export routes
nodes.description: Project a completed result for review, bind its snapshot token to that exact result, accept the Export click, and serve its transient attachment.

metadata.model-projection: Selected Studio server responsibilities; not a separately authored contract.

nodes.name: Bundle reviewed capture
nodes.description: Freeze the person’s exact approved Export selection.

nodes.name: Export
nodes.description: Translate an approved immutable capture into downloadable machine files and factual export findings.

nodes.name: Selected machine extension writer
nodes.description: Translate the prepared motion and captured machine settings into the selected output format through the Export writer interface.

metadata.model-projection: Selected extension adapter invoked by Export; not a standalone network service.

nodes.name: Transient artifacts and download capabilities
nodes.description: Own temporary machine-file bytes, finalize the selected artifact, lease exact bytes for retrieval, and release them on expiry, eviction or shutdown.

metadata.model-projection: Groups Export artifact storage and Studio attachment capability management at this level; these remain distinct implementation owners.
metadata.retention: The current Studio capability expires after ten minutes and may be evicted or released earlier. Temporary files are not stored in the print bundle.

relationships.description: The person inspects the displayed work and settings and chooses Export.

metadata.confirmation-boundary: The Export click is the only fabrication approval in this scope.

relationships.description: Read the coherent review state including the displayed completed-output snapshot token.

metadata.payload: Review state, captured settings and exportSnapshot token.

relationships.description: Read saved Bundle state and project the completed output for Studio.

metadata.payload: Saved neutral path/schedule, completed-output identity, captured plan and machine settings.

relationships.description: Submit the displayed exportSnapshot token and requested filename.

metadata.payload: exportSnapshot, name, downloadLink; response contains a prepared attachment capability.

relationships.description: Validate the displayed result and Bundle reservation, then export that captured state outside the edit/generation queue.

metadata.payload: Captured completed-output state and reservation identity.

relationships.description: Start an Export worker with the captured path, plan, machine snapshot and an owned temporary output directory; retain its factual preparation receipt.

metadata.payload: Immutable path artifact reference, captured plan/machine, release information; returns artifact identity and report.
metadata.transport: Node worker_threads; not an HTTP call.

relationships.description: Resolve the declared output adapter from the machine extension and invoke it with prepared motion and captured settings.

metadata.payload: Prepared motion, machine/setup/process/output settings and writer sink.

relationships.description: Create and finalize the owned artifact sink, or abort it on writing failure.
Write machine-program bytes through the supplied sink. Legacy whole-value adapters are composed into the same sink by Export.
Stage the prepared artifact behind an expiring download capability, then lease its exact bytes on retrieval.

metadata.payload: Owned artifact, output identity, report and filename; returns attachment URL or a readable lease.

relationships.description: Request the prepared attachment using its capability URL.

metadata.payload: Exact prepared machine-file bytes in an HTTP attachment.
metadata.evidence-limit: An HTTP response does not establish that the browser saved the file or that a printer ran it.

flows.name: Review a completed output
flows.description: Display an existing saved result and its captured settings for human review.

transitions.description: Inspect the work and settings in Studio.
Request the coherent review state.
Read the saved completed output and its captured inputs.
Return the exact completed result.
Return review state and the snapshot token bound to that result.

flows.name: Approve and prepare Export
flows.description: The person approves the displayed completed result; translation prepares transient bytes and a factual receipt.

transitions.description: Choose Export after reviewing the displayed work and settings.
Submit that displayed exportSnapshot token.
Check snapshot availability and reservation; invoke export on the captured state.
Validate the captured output and start its Export worker.
Create an owned transient artifact sink.
Resolve the selected adapter, prepare physical motion and invoke the writer.
Write the selected machine format into the sink.
Return writer facts and limitations.
Finalize the artifact after the writer completes.
Return artifact and report; Bundle attempts to record export-prepared with the captured output identity.
Return the prepared artifact and report to Studio.
Stage the artifact behind an expiring attachment capability.
Return the attachment URL, output identity and report to the browser.

flows.name: Retrieve the prepared program
flows.description: Request the exact prepared file. This flow establishes HTTP transfer only, not browser save completion or machine execution.

transitions.description: Request the capability URL, automatically after preparation or via the offered download link.
Resolve the capability and open a lease on its artifact.
Return a readable lease on the exact prepared bytes.
Stream the prepared attachment and close the read lease.
